answer.camera_language: Visible, gentle operator sway keeps the roadside exchange warm; measured approaches deepen their interest, tighten with the father's demand, then ease back into reflective distance.

clips.motivation: Keep the first exchange alive without making the handover feel momentous.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left and Kasun right, phone extended centrally
clips.lands_on: Both waist up, phone at Anudi's right waist
clips.composition_note: Balance both faces across the central handover, retaining the vehicle behind right.
clips.why: Gentle handheld sway makes their shared space welcoming; 35mm is the nearest supported substitute for 40mm, with distance adjusted to preserve the opening two-shot.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level waist-up two-shot, subtle handheld camera gently floating and swaying through the handover and thanks, easing into calm handles.

clips.motivation: Give the returned object a tactile emphasis that will contrast with its later interruption.
clips.opens_on: Phone centred between cream and faded blue sleeves
clips.lands_on: Phone supported by Anudi's right hand, Kasun's hand withdrawing right
clips.composition_note: A short lateral adjustment follows the handset without expanding the hand-only crop.
clips.why: A short move with the phone gives the detail life while keeping the transfer simple.
clips.camera_sentence: Waist-height, slightly high oblique insert; the camera moves slowly left with the handset during the transfer, settling before the final handle.

clips.motivation: Let his reassurance feel relaxed and unperformed.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third, looking left
clips.lands_on: Kasun in the same MCU with the vehicle soft behind
clips.composition_note: Leave conversational room to the left and retain his right-third placement.
clips.why: Visible operator float lends warmth without inflating his modest reply.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the frame gently floating and swaying through his reassurance, easing at either end without changing size.

clips.trigger: her interested look toward the business
clips.motivation: Make the change from gratitude to personal curiosity gently felt.
clips.opens_on: Anudi waist up at left, umbrella above and vehicle edge in right depth
clips.lands_on: Anudi in a loose MCU, still weighted left
clips.composition_note: Advance directly along the existing view, preserving room toward Kasun and the vehicle edge.
clips.why: Her first question earns a small but visible step closer.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium shot, the camera slowly pushes into a loose medium close-up as her curiosity turns into a question, settling before the cut.

clips.trigger: her attention rests on the business
clips.motivation: Give the modest business the attentive look her question implies.
clips.opens_on: Medium detail of the three-wheeler through its soft near edge
clips.lands_on: A slightly closer medium detail within the same foreground frame
clips.composition_note: Keep the near vehicle edge on one side throughout the short approach.
clips.why: A short creep makes this an interested look rather than a catalogue insert.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium detail with a soft foreground edge; the camera creeps slowly forward through the middle two seconds, remaining a medium view.

clips.motivation: Keep their growing interest reciprocal rather than assigning either person visual dominance.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left and Kasun right, both waist up
clips.lands_on: The same balanced pair with the business behind Kasun
clips.composition_note: Use the same central balance and visible gentle sway as the first A setup.
clips.why: The shared frame sustains equality; the same 35mm substitute for the unavailable 40mm preserves setup A's established framing.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level waist-up two-shot, subtle handheld camera gently floating and swaying throughout the exchange, easing into the final handle.

clips.trigger: L7, his account of starting alone
clips.motivation: Give his ambition increasing emotional weight without turning it into a boast.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third
clips.lands_on: Kasun in a close-up, looking left
clips.composition_note: Retain left eyeline space as the chest crop tightens to his face.
clips.why: His hopeful account earns a sustained approach while retaining setup B's calm operated character.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes toward his face through his account of the business, reaching a close-up before the tail handle.

clips.direction: slightly right within the face-and-phone frame
clips.trigger: her appreciative reaction before the ring
clips.motivation: Carry the warmth into the interruption without competing with the rising phone.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face upper left and phone low right
clips.lands_on: Anudi's face upper left with the raised screen in the right foreground
clips.composition_note: A small visible lateral float preserves both the face and the screen's established foreground area.
clips.why: The frame is still emotionally connected to the conversation until the isolated caller display arrests it.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level three-quarter close-up, the camera drifts gently right through her reaction and the ring, easing to a settled frame as the screen comes up.

clips.motivation: Make the readable caller display a hard interruption to the living conversational frames.
clips.opens_on: The incoming-call display reading Father, supported by Anudi's right hand
clips.lands_on: The same readable display and supporting hand
clips.composition_note: Centre the display, placing its entire surface within the focus plane.
clips.why: This deliberate stillness gives the caller's identity a clean reading and stops the scene's warmth for a beat.
clips.camera_sentence: High-oblique extreme close-up of the display, the camera holds completely still for the full take.

clips.trigger: she brings the phone to her ear
clips.motivation: Keep the greeting ordinary before the father's demand changes its meaning.
clips.opens_on: Anudi head and shoulders at left, phone raised
clips.lands_on: Anudi in the same MCU with the phone at her ear
clips.composition_note: Keep her on the left third with soft open space to the right.
clips.why: A living but unassertive frame lets the greeting remain familiar rather than ominous.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the frame gently floats and sways as she answers, maintaining its size and easing before the tail handle.

clips.motivation: Let the external demand visibly close in on her without ever leaving the listener.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face and phone in close-up on the left third
clips.lands_on: A tighter close-up of her listening face and phone
clips.composition_note: Reduce the surrounding space steadily while retaining the left-weighted face and phone.
clips.why: The longest, most insistent approach belongs to the scene's emotional turn rather than its flirtation.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close-up, the camera slowly and steadily pushes closer throughout her father's demand, reaching a tight close-up and settling before the tail handle.

clips.direction: toward Anudi beneath the umbrella edge
clips.motivation: Sustain the pressure while the foreground separates her from the earlier shared space.
clips.opens_on: Three-quarter MCU of Anudi in the left half beneath the soft umbrella edge
clips.lands_on: A tighter MCU with open space still to her right
clips.composition_note: Maintain the soft umbrella edge above left without passing it or filling the right-hand space.
clips.why: The uninterrupted creep sustains her isolation; 65mm substitutes for the unsupported 75mm with distance adjusted to retain the planned MCU.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level three-quarter medium close-up, the camera creeps visibly but very slowly closer as she listens, remaining within medium close-up and easing before the end.

clips.motivation: Release the approaching pressure into a restrained, subdued response.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face and phone close on the left third
clips.lands_on: The same close-up after her response
clips.composition_note: Retain setup E's left placement with visible slow operator sway rather than a further advance.
clips.why: Stopping the advance gives her compliance room to register without freezing the human presence of the camera.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close-up, the frame gently floats and sways very slowly as her smile fades and she replies, keeping the same close framing.

clips.trigger: she lowers the phone and returns her look
clips.motivation: Restore their shared geography while allowing the interruption to remain between them.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left with phone at ear, Kasun right beside the vehicle
clips.lands_on: Both waist up facing one another, phone lowered
clips.composition_note: Return precisely to setup A's balance, with slower visible sway than in the opening exchange.
clips.why: The familiar shared frame now feels more reserved; the same 35mm substitute for 40mm maintains setup continuity.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level waist-up two-shot, subtle handheld camera gently floating and swaying very slowly as she returns to the conversation and says goodbye.

clips.motivation: Give his observation a private beat without suggesting knowledge of the call.
clips.opens_on: Kasun's face on the right with left negative space
clips.lands_on: The same isolated close-up as his eyeline returns left
clips.composition_note: Retain generous space to the left and let the vehicle dissolve behind his right side.
clips.why: A gently breathing long-lens close-up observes his uncertainty without editorial insistence.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level oblique close-up, the frame gently floats and sways very slowly through his lowered gaze and return, easing into the final handle.

clips.motivation: Keep his farewell considerate and unforced after the emotional interruption.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third, looking left
clips.lands_on: Kasun in the same MCU after his farewell
clips.composition_note: Match setup B's right-third portrait and leftward conversational space.
clips.why: Returning to the earlier portrait without another push lets his warmth remain simple.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the frame gently floats and sways very slowly through his farewell, maintaining the same size and easing before the end.

clips.direction: gently around the space between their paths
clips.motivation: Allow their diverging paths and Kasun's hesitation to coexist without choosing whom to follow.
clips.opens_on: Both full figures, Anudi left and Kasun right with the vehicle behind
clips.lands_on: Anudi in left depth and Kasun near the vehicle in right depth
clips.composition_note: Keep both depth paths and the separating roadside visible through a slow, visible operator sway.
clips.why: The wide remains an impartial witness to the separation rather than abandoning one person for the other.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level wide shot, the frame gently floats and sways very slowly as their paths separate, preserving the wide composition and easing before the tail handle.

clips.trigger: their continued movement into opposite depths
clips.motivation: Let the encounter recede into the wet roadside while retaining its emotional afterimage.
clips.opens_on: Wide wet foreground with Anudi small left and Kasun small right beside the vehicle
clips.lands_on: A wider roadside view with more empty foreground separating the distant figures
clips.composition_note: Retreat straight back, increasing wet foreground while retaining both paths at opposite sides.
clips.why: The retreat closes the scene with distance rather than emphasis; 35mm replaces the unsupported 32mm with the opening wide framing preserved by camera distance.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level wide shot, the camera slowly pulls backward as they recede, expanding the foreground through the middle three seconds and settling before the cut.

notes: 4K-1: lens 85mm macro -> 85mm (the frame brief must follow)
4J-1: lens 100mm macro -> 100mm (the frame brief must follow)
